newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss building applications off 0.3 pct by end-May.
newsitem.headline: Swiss building applications off 0.3 pct by end-May.

text.p: Swiss applications for building permits fell 0.3 percent in the first five months of 1997 from the year-earlier period to 10,685 at end-May, a survey by the Swiss Construction Information Centre found.
The May index (May 1989 = 100) stood at 79.34 points.
Applications for large-scale renovations rose 1.3 percent in the period, while those for new buildings fell 1.5 percent.
Applications for housing projects was up 2.2 percent from a year earlier, while public-sector projects rose 19.2 percent, it said in a statement.
